import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec=json.loads((ROOT/"control/project_tasks/DEV-PRED-A2Z-POSTBUILD-RETRY-20261006-E106.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
matches=[op for op in spec.get("operations",[]) if op.get("type")=="write_text" and op.get("path")=="control/dev_checks/a2z_previous_selection.json"]

out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2,sort_keys=False,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")

print("ORIGINATING_TASK="+obj["originating_task_id"])
